title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 3.67 (unsettled) at 10:00 UTC on 25 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 25 日 10:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 3.67（不穩定）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 3.67 (4M) at 10:00 UTC on 25 September. The 10:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 10:59; hour-start 3.67/4M, hour-end 4.00/4Z). Last-180 maximum is 4.00 (first at 2026-09-25T08:09:00 UTC; label 4Z). Published-window maximum is 4.00 (first at 2026-09-25T07:47:00 UTC; label 4Z). Window start 2026-09-25T05:11:00 UTC (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 11:00 UTC hour on 25 September is still incomplete (9 samples).

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of the most complete recent hour (10:00 UTC on 25 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 10:00 UTC is 3.67/4M and the hour ends 4.00/4Z at 10:59. The 11:00 UTC hour on 25 September is incomplete (9 samples through 11:08).
